scope: Finished PDF structure, exact selected-page sequence, explicit redirects, attachment identity, source/editorial text survival, vector geometry, and source/glossary link semantics; not mathematical verification.
normalization: NFKC; remove whitespace, soft hyphen, zero-width space and BOM only. Source characters must survive as a contiguous block or ordered subsequence in extraction order.
audit_method_corrections: The first audit assumed whitespace before a destination name. Valid compact PDF arrays such as [5/Fit] are now parsed.

Only invalid extreme-coordinate empty-path sentinels remain unchanged and require exact source/output equality. Valid zero-area path bboxes are transformed normally; confusing those categories caused 218 warnings in the retained intermediate audit.
